data: What percentage of the inference time is dedicated to the Decoder?

The pie chart in Figure 1 shows the distribution of inference time across three components: Encoder, Decoder, and Others. The percentage of time dedicated to each component is clearly labeled within the corresponding sections of the pie chart. 

To determine the percentage of the inference time dedicated to the Decoder, we can directly read this value from the chart. The section labeled "Decoder" occupies 54% of the pie chart.

Thus, the percentage of the inference time dedicated to the Decoder is 54%.
